meta.name: dynamic-archify
meta.description: Create professional architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle/state diagrams as standalone animated HTML files with SVG graphics, flowing animation effects, a built-in dark/light theme toggle, and one-click export to PNG / JPEG / WebP / SVG / GIF / WebM. Accepts plain-language descriptions or pasted Mermaid code and lays the diagram out from scratch. Use when the user asks for system architecture diagrams, infrastructure diagrams, cloud architecture visualizations, security diagrams, network topology, technical workflows, approval flows, runbooks, CI/CD flows, process diagrams, API call sequences, request lifecycles, data pipelines, ETL/ELT maps, PII boundaries, data lineage, state machines, lifecycle diagrams, status transitions, or asks to convert/beautify a Mermaid diagram.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成带动画的架构与流程图,一键导出多种格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要绘制架构图、流程图但不想手动排版
copy.tagline_en: Generate animated architecture and workflow diagrams from text, with one-click export.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need architecture diagrams but don't want to draw them manually.

howto.what: 将用户用文字描述的架构、流程、时序、数据流或生命周期等内容，渲染为独立的HTML文件：内含SVG图形、流动动画效果、深/浅主题切换按钮，并可一键导出PNG、JPEG等格式；也接受Mermaid代码并重新布局。
howto.when: 当用户提到“架构图”“流程图”“时序图”等关键词，或要求绘制系统架构、技术流程、API调用序列等图，或要求转换/美化Mermaid图时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这段Mermaid代码转成架构图
say.note: 会读取代码结构并重新生成HTML架构图

say.text: 画一个用户登录的时序图
say.note: 生成带明暗主题切换的动画时序图
输出可导出多种格式的流程图

howto.what_en: Generates standalone animated HTML diagrams (SVG) with a dark/light theme toggle and one-click export to PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/GIF/WebM. Accepts plain-language descriptions or Mermaid code and lays out the diagram from scratch.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions keywords like “architecture diagram”, “flowchart”, or “sequence diagram”, asks for architecture/workflow/sequence/data-flow/lifecycle visuals, or asks to convert/beautify a Mermaid diagram.

say_en.text: Turn this Mermaid code into an architecture diagram.
say_en.note: Reads the code structure and regenerates an HTML diagram.

say_en.text: Draw a sequence diagram for user login.
say_en.note: Generates an animated sequence diagram with theme toggle.
Outputs an exportable flowchart as an HTML file.
